sentences.zh: 这是迈克。

sentences.en: Mike, hi, it's Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 迈克，嗨，我是萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I have a different job now, which is why you haven't heard from me in a while.
sentences.zh: 我现在换了新工作，这也是你为什么有一段时间没听到我消息的原因。

sentences.en: Wait, am I allowed to ask?
sentences.zh: 等等，我可以问吗？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？

sentences.en: I'm hosting The Daily, so I'm one of the hosts.
sentences.zh: 我在主持《每日新闻》（The Daily），我是主持人之一。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你。

sentences.en: That's really cool.
sentences.zh: 这真的很酷。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to take a look at a couple of different states and really just, like,
sentences.zh: 我正试图了解几个不同的州，真的就是，呃，

sentences.en: talk to folks in the pro-life movement in those places and just sort of see where people's heads are at right now,
sentences.zh: 与这些地方的反堕胎运动人士交谈，看看大家现在的想法，

sentences.en: you know, what they're thinking, what they're talking about, what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在想什么，他们在谈论什么，他们在做什么。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: So, Mike, first, why don't you do something for me before we even start.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，首先，在我们开始之前，能帮我做件事吗。

sentences.en: ID yourself for me.
sentences.zh: 请做一下自我介绍。

sentences.en: So tell me your name and your title and your age, if you don't mind.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的话，告诉我你的名字、头衔和年龄。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Michael Ganadakis, president of Ohio Right to Life.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·加纳达基斯，俄亥俄州反堕胎组织（Ohio Right to Life）主席。

sentences.en: Our state headquarters for Ohio Right to Life are located in Columbus, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我们俄亥俄州反堕胎组织的州总部位于俄亥俄州哥伦布市。

sentences.en: I'm 48 years old, 22-year practicing attorney.
sentences.zh: 我今年48岁，是一名有22年执业经验的律师。

sentences.en: And I think that's all.
sentences.zh: 我想就这些了。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: So tell me, Mike, where you were when you heard the news of this leak.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我，迈克，你听到这次泄密消息时在哪里？

sentences.en: So, full transparency, I was sitting on my back patio watching my children jump on the trampoline
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我当时正坐在后院露台上看孩子们在蹦床上跳跃，

sentences.en: when I received a call from the Senate president for the state of Ohio asking me if I heard the news.
sentences.zh: 这时我接到俄亥俄州参议院议长的电话，问我有没有听到这个消息。

sentences.en: And at first I thought it was a joke and a prank, of course.
sentences.zh: 起初我以为这只是个玩笑和恶作剧。

sentences.en: And then I asked him to send me verification immediately and he sent me a tweet and my world got turned upside down.
sentences.zh: 然后我要求他立刻发给我验证消息，他发给我了一条推文，我的世界顿时天翻地覆。

sentences.en: I hung up the phone with him and immediately, you know, the news just started cascading and boiling over and my phone started to explode and blow up.
sentences.zh: 我挂断他的电话，然后，你知道的，新闻就开始铺天盖地、沸沸扬扬地涌来，我的电话开始被打爆。

sentences.en: It's been a whirlwind of a past 20-some hours.
sentences.zh: 过去这二十多小时简直是一场旋风。

sentences.en: And it's not about me, of course, but being able to have a front row seat to watch history being changed,
sentences.zh: 当然，这与我无关，但能有幸坐在前排见证历史的改变，

sentences.en: you know, I'm speechless and I still am because I just want to, I'm expecting to wake up and realize it was a dream when in fact it's not, it's reality.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时说不出话来，现在也是，因为我只想、我正等着醒来发现这只是一场梦，但事实上并非如此，这是现实。

sentences.en: Now, I have to temper this with, we've seen a draft opinion.
sentences.zh: 现在，我必须冷静地说，我们看到的只是一份意见草案。

sentences.en: It's not the final opinion.
sentences.zh: 这不是最终意见。

sentences.en: So things could change.
sentences.zh: 所以事情可能会改变。

sentences.en: I don't believe they will, but they could.
sentences.zh: 我不认为会变，但确实有可能。

sentences.en: Were you happy?
sentences.zh: 你高兴吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this has been your life's work for how many years?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是你为之奋斗了多少年的毕生事业？

sentences.en: 14 years I've been with Ohio Right to Life.
sentences.zh: 我在俄亥俄州反堕胎组织工作了14年。

sentences.en: And, you know, happy is one word, but, you know, in pure transparency, I was nervous, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，高兴是一个词，但坦白说，我很紧张，你知道的，

sentences.en: because I said to myself, we've been talking a lot lately about what a post-Rowe Ohio or a post-Rowe America would look like.
sentences.zh: 因为我对自已说，我们最近一直在讨论“罗诉韦德案”之后俄亥俄州或美国会是什么样子。

sentences.en: But now we actually have to do it.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们真的必须去面对它了。

sentences.en: And that's a blessing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件幸事。

sentences.en: Don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: 别误会我的意思。

sentences.en: But it also, it makes me nervous because we're in uncharted territory.
sentences.zh: 但这也让我感到紧张，因为我们正处于未知的领域。

sentences.en: There's no book, there's no manual written by someone in the 80s or the 90s or some, you know, legal scholar writing something on how to do this, that, or the other.
sentences.zh: 没有书，没有80年代或90年代的人写的手册，也没有什么法律学者写的东西来教你如何处理这个或那个。

sentences.en: And it's imperative upon us now to work even harder to make sure that we have social services and a safety net for women who find themselves in the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我们现在必须更加努力地工作，确保为意外怀孕的女性提供社会服务和安全网，这是我们的责任。

sentences.en: You know, the dynamics and the messaging and the strategy completely change now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，现在态势、信息传递和战略已经完全改变了。

sentences.en: And we're going to have to rewrite the playbook.
sentences.zh: 我们必须重写应对方案。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔维尼斯。

sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Even before the leaked Supreme Court opinion, figures on both sides of the abortion fight were preparing for the end of Roe.
sentences.zh: 甚至在最高法院意见遭泄露之前，堕胎之争双方的人物就已经在为“罗案”的终结做准备了。

sentences.en: In the days since, they've been scrambling.
sentences.zh: 自那之后的几天里，他们一直在手忙脚乱。

sentences.en: Today, in the first of two parts, we talk to the anti-abortion activists about what the fight looks like after you already seem to have won.
sentences.zh: 今天，在分两部分的节目的第一部分中，我们与反堕胎活动人士交谈，讨论在似乎已经获胜之后，这场斗争会是什么样子。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔维尼斯。

sentences.zh: 琳赛·加里森也在在线。

sentences.zh: 嗨，萨姆。

sentences.en: Yeah, good to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴跟你说话。

sentences.en: How you been doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Pretty good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.zh: 萨姆，你在哪里接听我们的电话？

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: I am in the state capitol.
sentences.zh: 我在州议会大厦。

sentences.en: I found a cubbyhole, which is relatively quiet.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一个相对安静的小隔间。

sentences.en: And I don't think anyone will disturb me here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在这里没有人会打扰我。

sentences.en: But you just never know because sometimes people look for quiet cubbyholes to make their own phone calls.
sentences.zh: 但你永远说不准，因为有时人们会找安静的小隔间来打自己的电话。

sentences.en: So we're in the last two weeks of the session trying to get a pro-life bill passed and trying to get a constitutional amendment put on the ballot in Missouri that would make the state constitution abortion neutral.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正处于本届会议的最后两周，试图通过一项反堕胎法案，并试图在密苏里州将一项宪法修正案付诸表决，该修正案将使州宪法对堕胎保持中立。

sentences.en: We have some increases on funding for alternatives to abortion.
sentences.zh: 我们增加了一些对堕胎替代方案的资金支持。

sentences.en: And also there's language to try to, again, defund Planned Parenthood, but in a different way that might be upheld by our state Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一些措辞试图再次取消对“计划生育”组织的资助，但采用了可能得到我们州最高法院支持的不同方式。

sentences.en: So, Sam, it sounds like you've been pretty busy.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，听起来你最近非常忙。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: It's been a busy year, but a good year.
sentences.zh: 这是忙碌的一年，但也是美好的一年。

sentences.en: I mean, not an untypical year, but just, you know, just a little bit of this, a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是不寻常的一年，只是，你知道的，有点这样，有点那样。

sentences.en: But I'm Samuel H.
sentences.zh: 我是塞缪尔·H·

sentences.en: Lee.
sentences.zh: 李。

sentences.zh: 大家都叫我萨姆，我是密苏里州生命运动（Campaign Lives Missouri）的主任，是密苏里州资深的反堕胎游说者，我今年64岁。

sentences.en: And how long have you been working on the abortion issue, Sam?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，你从事堕胎问题的工作多久了？

sentences.en: Well, it's been it's not close to 40 years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，快有40年了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: 40 years.
I've been lobbying full time 37 years, but I started a couple of years before that part time.
sentences.zh: 我全职游说已经37年了，但在此之前几年我兼职开始做。

sentences.en: So it's close to 40 years lobbying at the state capitol.
sentences.zh: 所以在州议会大厦进行游说已经接近40年了。

sentences.en: And I it's just something that I really enjoy doing.
sentences.zh: 而且我真的很喜欢做这件事。

sentences.en: And I love the place.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个地方。

sentences.en: I love the people.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这里的人。

sentences.en: I love the work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这项工作。

sentences.en: I'm just really blessed to be able to come to the state capitol and do this every year.
sentences.zh: 能够每年都来州议会大厦做这件事，我真的很幸运。

sentences.en: So where were you when you heard the news of the leaked decision?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你听到关于裁决泄露的消息时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: I was leaving St. Louis to drive to Jefferson City about two hours away.
sentences.zh: 我正离开圣路易斯开车去两个小时车程外的杰斐逊城。

sentences.en: We've had a confirmation of kids at our Catholic church where I'm a deacon and had just finished up with that and was checking my phone for messages.
sentences.zh: 我们天主教教堂的孩子们刚刚完成了坚信礼，我是那里的执事，刚刚忙完这件事，正在查看手机上的信息。

sentences.en: And some of my colleagues who are state legislators, they were tweeting out the Politico story.
sentences.zh: 我的一些身为州议员的同事在推特上转发了政客新闻网（Politico）的报道。

sentences.en: And it's like, whoa, what's this?
sentences.zh: 当时感觉就像，哇，这是什么？

sentences.en: What's the first thing that went through your head when you saw that news?
sentences.zh: 当你看到这个消息时，脑子里闪过的第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: What's the first thing that came to mind?
sentences.zh: 脑海中浮现的第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: I'm still not convinced that the Supreme Court will use this case to overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我仍然不相信最高法院会利用这个案件来推翻“罗诉韦德案”。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: I hope I'm wrong in my analysis, but I'm not convinced it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 但愿我的分析是错的，但我并不确信这会发生。

sentences.en: So skeptical, but also happy.
sentences.zh: 所以既持怀疑态度，但也感到高兴。

sentences.en: Happy, maybe this is I'm not going to say the end or the beginning of the end,
sentences.zh: 高兴，也许这是——我不会说这是结束或结束的开始，

sentences.en: but maybe this is the transition point that the pro-life movement and this country needs to get away from court supervised abortion law and return it to the states to decide.
sentences.zh: 但也许这是反堕胎运动和这个国家所需要的转折点，摆脱最高法院监督的堕胎法，将其交还给各州决定。

sentences.en: But we'll see.
sentences.zh: 但我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: So, Sam, you learned this news.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，你得知了这个消息。

sentences.en: What did you do first when you woke up?
sentences.zh: 你醒来后的第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: Like what I do every morning is do my morning prayer.
sentences.zh: 就像我每天早晨做的那样，做早祷。

sentences.en: And that's the very first thing.
sentences.zh: 那是绝对的第一件事。

sentences.en: A book of PsalMs.
sentences.zh: 一本诗篇。

sentences.en: It's actually on my it's an app I use on my phone and do my morning prayer and got ready and came over to the state capitol.
sentences.zh: 实际上它在我的——那是我手机上使用的一个应用程序，我做了早祷，然后准备好，来到了州议会大厦。

sentences.en: When you went to the statehouse, what was the mood?
sentences.zh: 当你去州议会大厦时，那里的气氛怎么样？

sentences.en: What were people talking about?
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论什么？

sentences.en: Could you sense that this thing had happened?
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到这件事已经发生了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, they were definitely talking.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们绝对在讨论。

sentences.en: It's like the topic of discussion among my circle of lawmakers and other lobbyists about, well, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 这就像是我身边的立法者和其它游说者圈子里的讨论话题，比如，嗯，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Is this it?
sentences.zh: 就是这样吗？

sentences.en: A lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 有很多问题。

sentences.en: You know, is this the one?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，是这个吗？

sentences.en: Is this the case?
sentences.zh: 是这个案子吗？

sentences.en: It's going to overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 它会推翻“罗诉韦德案”吗？

sentences.en: Wade?
sentences.zh: 韦德案？

sentences.en: I said, maybe.
sentences.zh: 我说，也许吧。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 但愿如此。

sentences.en: But we'll have to see.
sentences.zh: 但我们还得拭目以待。

sentences.en: People were saying, well, congratulating me and, you know, this is what you've worked for and things like that.
sentences.zh: 人们说，嗯，向我表示祝贺，你知道的，这就是你为之奋斗的目标之类的话。

sentences.en: I'm glad for the high five.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能击掌相庆。

sentences.en: I've been glad for the thank yous, even, for the work that I've done.
sentences.zh: 甚至对于我所做的工作，我也很高兴听到谢谢。

sentences.zh: 但正如我向许多人解释的那样，我们还有更多工作要做。

sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，具有讽刺意味的是，因为有些人认为“罗诉韦德案”已被推翻，通过反堕胎法案的意愿可能会降低。

sentences.zh: 韦德案被推翻，通过反堕胎法案的意愿可能会降低。

sentences.en: So that's, that's something I have to contend with as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是我必须应对的问题。

sentences.en: Like, well, no, we still have work to do, even if, even if Roe v.

sentences.en: Wade is overturned in late June or early July, there's still other legislation we need to pass.

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.zh: 所以感觉人们好像已经觉得，好吧，事情结束了。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 所以这也是我一直在应对的问题。

sentences.zh: 那么，萨姆，我们来做一个假设。

sentences.zh: 比方说，《罗诉韦德案》被推翻了。

sentences.en: Say, Supreme Court decision comes out last day of June, 10 a.m., by 2 p.m., it's outlawed in the state of Missouri.
sentences.zh: 假设最高法院在6月的最后一天上午10点做出裁决，到了下午2点，它在密苏里州就被宣布为非法。

sentences.en: What does that mean for you and for your organization?
sentences.zh: 这对你和你的组织意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, are you finished?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你们结束了吗？

sentences.en: Is your work done?
sentences.zh: 你们的工作完成了？

sentences.en: That's it?
sentences.zh: 就这样？

sentences.en: Oh, not at all.
sentences.zh: 哦，完全没有。

sentences.en: We'll be attempts to undo that either by pro-choice legislators in the next legislative session, which would begin in January,
sentences.zh: 支持堕胎的立法者会在一月份开始的下一个立法会议上尝试撤销这一决定，

sentences.en: or there might be an initiative petition to pass a right to abortion in state statute or even an attempted constitutional amendment.
sentences.zh: 或者可能会通过一项公民提案，在州法律中通过堕胎权，甚至是尝试进行宪法修正案。

sentences.en: And also, we just have so many women who are now leaving the state for their abortions.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们现在有那么多的女性正在离开本州去进行堕胎。

sentences.en: How do we reach out to them?
sentences.zh: 我们如何联系她们？

sentences.en: And this just concerns me more than anything.
sentences.zh: 这比什么都让我担心。

sentences.en: There are women who are either going out of state.
sentences.zh: 有些女性要么去外州，

sentences.en: They're ordering abortion pills through offshore companies from India.
sentences.zh: 要么通过印度的海外公司订购堕胎药。

sentences.en: And, you know, our laws are designed,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们的法律旨在——

sentences.en: and I've worked hard to make sure that they're designed so that there's never going to be a prosecution and will not be a prosecution of a woman for procuring an abortion or buying abortion pills on the Internet or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我努力确保它们的制定是为了永远不会起诉，也不会起诉为了堕胎或在网上购买堕胎药而行事的女性，诸如此类。

sentences.en: The doctor, that's a different story.
sentences.zh: 医生则是另一回事。

sentences.en: Someone who facilitates that, that's different.
sentences.zh: 协助这一行为的人，情况就不同了。

sentences.en: We have a bill this year that makes it a felony, a high-level felony, to either import or procure or administer abortion pills unlawfully in the state of Missouri.
sentences.zh: 我们今年有一项法案，规定在密苏里州非法输入、采购或提供堕胎药为重罪，高级重罪。

sentences.en: But that's just part of the story.
sentences.zh: 但这只是故事的一部分。

sentences.en: How do we deal with women who leave the state to have abortions, you know, primarily in Kansas and Illinois?
sentences.zh: 我们如何处理那些离开本州去堕胎的女性，你知道的，主要是在堪萨斯州和伊利诺伊州？

sentences.en: How do we reach those women and provide the alternatives that they may not even be aware are available to them?
sentences.zh: 我们如何接触这些女性并提供她们甚至可能不知道存在的替代选择？

sentences.en: And that, to me, is the challenge.
sentences.zh: 对我和整个运动来说，这才是挑战。

sentences.en: The numbers of women who have been going to Kansas have actually increased slightly, and the numbers going to Illinois have just increased astronomically.
sentences.zh: 前往堪萨斯州的女性人数实际上略有增加，而前往伊利诺伊州的人数则是呈几何级数增长。

sentences.en: So that's the challenge that we face, and how do you craft legislation that deals with that?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们面临的挑战，你该如何制定应对这一情况的法律？

sentences.en: Are you worried that if Roe is eventually overturned, that it might actually just diffuse the movement altogether, that people will just kind of go on to other things?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心，如果《罗诉韦德案》最终被推翻，它可能反而会彻底消解这场运动，人们只会转向其他事情？

sentences.en: I mean, that would be the end, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那就结束了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, how do you see what might happen?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你如何看待可能发生的事情？

sentences.en: Yeah, that could happen, and I think that's just looking at other social movements.
sentences.zh: 是的，这可能会发生，我想这只需看看其他社会运动就知道了。

sentences.en: But there is a core group of pro-lifers and people involved in pro-life who are going to stay in.
sentences.zh: 但仍有一核心群体的反堕胎人士和参与其中并会坚持到底的人。

sentences.en: The candidates are still going to be running on this issue.
sentences.zh: 候选人仍将围绕这个议题竞选。

sentences.en: Does it worry me?
sentences.zh: 这让我担心吗？

sentences.en: Yes, but it doesn't worry me to the point of where I can't function or others can't function.
sentences.zh: 是的，但这并没有让我担心到无法运作或其他人无法运作的地步。

sentences.en: You just deal with it as it comes up.
sentences.zh: 事情发生时你去应对它就是了。

sentences.en: But I think, yes, it's a possibility.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，是的，这是有可能的。

sentences.en: Is there a possibility that there's a backlash?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能产生强烈的反弹？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: But we're better off not having the Supreme Court and the courts deciding what abortion policy should be, but leaving it up to legislative bodies and the political process.
sentences.zh: 但由立法机构和政治进程来决定堕胎政策应该是什么，而不是由最高法院和法院来决定，我们要好得多。

sentences.en: I think that's a far better alternative than what we've been working under for close to 50 years now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这比我们近50年来一直沿用的方式要好得多。

sentences.en: Sam, I'm just going to ask you to reflect back to when you started in the movement in the 70s and compare that to now.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，我想请你回想一下你在70年代刚加入这场运动的时候，并将其与现在进行比较。

sentences.en: I mean, how would you describe what it was like to be in the movement back then and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你如何形容当年的运动是什么样的，而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: the extent to which you were winning or not winning and how that feeling compares to today?
sentences.zh: 你当时赢了还是没赢，这种感觉与今天相比如何？

sentences.en: You know, it was the feeling of an obligation, of a calling remains.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种责任感、使命感依然存在。

sentences.en: It's never changed for, gosh, since 1978 when I first got involved.
sentences.zh: 自从1978年我第一次参与以来，天哪，它从未改变。

sentences.en: I will say what's different is that it's not as simple as we thought back then.
sentences.zh: 我要说不同的是，事情并不像我们当时想象的那么简单。

sentences.en: It's – I will say that one of the biggest regrets – it's not something that the pro-life movement caused, but one of the biggest regrets is the partisan divide.
sentences.zh: 我要说——最大的遗憾之一——这不是反堕胎运动造成的，但最大的遗憾之一是党派分歧。

sentences.en: When I first got involved, there were lots of Democrats who were pro-life, and now it's – that's completely changed.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次参与时，有很多民主党人是反堕胎的，现在——这完全变了。

sentences.en: And the pro-life movement will not be sustainable in the long run unless we have influence in both political parties.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，如果我们不在两个政党中都有影响力，反堕胎运动是无法持续的。

sentences.en: And I don't know how to get there in the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如何在民主党内部做到这一点。

sentences.en: I simply don't.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道。

sentences.en: And until we do, this is not going to end.
sentences.zh: 在我们做到这一点之前，这一切都不会结束。

sentences.en: It's going to, you know, go back and forth depending on who's president or governor at a particular time period, who issues what executive orders.
sentences.zh: 它会，你知道的，根据特定时期谁是总统或州长，谁发布了什么样的行政命令而反复摇摆。

sentences.en: So that certainly has changed where there's this great divide.
sentences.zh: 所以这种巨大分歧肯定已经改变了。

sentences.en: I think it also that – that as politicized as abortion has been, as long as I can remember, it's even more so.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是——堕胎被政治化的程度，在我记事起，就甚至比以前更甚了。

sentences.en: And that works against the pro-life movement.
sentences.zh: 这对反堕胎运动是不利的。

sentences.en: If we're seen primarily as a tool or an arm of the Republican Party, that makes it harder for us to do our job.
sentences.zh: 如果我们主要被视为共和党的工具或分支，这会让我们更难做好工作。

sentences.en: You know, I still enjoy the work as much as I ever have and still feel called to do it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我依然像以往一样享受这项工作，并且仍然觉得有使命去做这件事。

sentences.en: But it's more challenging, and it's going to have to be a younger generation,
sentences.zh: 但这更具挑战性，而且将不得不依靠年轻一代，

sentences.en: which is going to have to rethink what the pro-life movement has done and come up with maybe different solutions or better solutions in some cases.
sentences.zh: 他们必须重新思考反堕胎运动所做的事情，并在某些情况下提出不同的解决方案或更好的解决方案。

sentences.en: You know, one of these days I'll get too old to do this, but I'm not too old right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总有一天我会老得做不动了，但我现在还没老。

sentences.en: I believe it was late evening, and it was dinnertime where I live.
sentences.zh: 我记得那是深夜，正是我住的地方吃晚饭的时候。

sentences.en: So I was cooking dinner for my family, making fajitas, and I just checked my phone, and it's, like, blowing up.
sentences.zh: 所以我正在为家人做晚饭，做墨西哥法士达，我只是看了一下手机，它就像炸锅了一样。

sentences.en: And I was stunned.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了。

sentences.en: I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，什么？

sentences.en: Like, oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦天哪。

sentences.en: Like, is this real?
sentences.zh: 就像，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: Like, I need to go read these.
sentences.zh: 就像，我得去读读这些。

sentences.en: So my mom was kind enough to take over dinner for me while I was able to catch up on the news.
sentences.zh: 所以我妈妈很好地帮我接管了晚饭，而我则能够赶上新闻。

sentences.en: And at first, to be honest, I was in disbelief, and a part of me was, I don't even know if celebrating is the right word, but a part of me was, wow, like,
sentences.zh: 起初，说实话，我处于难以置信的状态，我的一部分——我甚至不知道庆祝是不是正确的词——但我的一部分心想，哇，

sentences.en: we worked so hard for this.
sentences.zh: 我们为之付出了这么多努力。

sentences.en: I've worked so hard for this.
sentences.zh: 我为之付出了这么多努力。

sentences.en: But a part of me was, like, I'm also terrified.
sentences.zh: 但我的一部分心想，我也很害怕。

sentences.en: Terrified?
sentences.zh: 害怕？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because the amount of women that needed her help before and will need her help post-Rowe.
sentences.zh: 因为以前需要她帮助的女性数量，以及在《罗诉韦德案》之后将需要她帮助的女性数量。

sentences.en: Our work is not over.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作还没有结束。

sentences.en: Our work is far from over.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作远未结束。

sentences.en: Our work is really, honestly, just beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作真的，老实说，才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: My name is Jess Meath, and I am the National Communications Director for Democrats for Life of America.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰斯·米丝（Jess Meath），我是美国生命民主党人全国传讯总监。

sentences.en: I am 26 years old, and I like to say that my pro-life journey technically begins on March 17, 1996, when I was adopted from China.
sentences.zh: 我26岁，我喜欢说我的反堕胎之旅技术上始于1996年3月17日，当时我被从中国收养。

sentences.en: I was adopted because of the one-child policy.
sentences.zh: 我因为独生子女政策而被收养。

sentences.en: I don't know who my real parents are.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的亲生父母是谁。

sentences.en: I don't even know, really, when my real birthday is.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道，说实话，我的真正生日是什么时候。

sentences.en: But what I do know is that I'm here.
sentences.zh: 但我知道的是我在这里。

sentences.en: I'm alive, and someone somewhere chose life for me.
sentences.zh: 我还活着，某处的某个人为我选择了生命。

sentences.en: I am here for a reason.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里是有原因的。

sentences.en: I remember hearing about adoption as just one of the aspects in the pro-life movement.
sentences.zh: 我记得听说收养只是反堕胎运动中的一个方面。

sentences.en: And it made me think about my own story.
sentences.zh: 这让我思考我自己的故事。

sentences.en: And I understand and I'm learning that China's one-child policy is not Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我理解并且我正在了解中国的独生子女政策不是《罗诉韦德案》。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德。

sentences.en: I get that they're two different things, but it was, to me, I saw it as it's still regarding the right to life, that that's the core issue.
sentences.zh: 我明白它们是两码事，但对我来说，我看到它仍然关乎生存权，那是核心议题。

sentences.en: That was when I started to understand the value and dignity of every human life and every person.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，我开始理解每一个生命和每个人的价值与尊严。

sentences.en: I remember when I was at my Catholic school, I learned that life begins at conception.
sentences.zh: 我记得在天主教学校时，我了解到生命始于受孕。

sentences.en: And for me, I, you know, I took it as, okay, wow, okay, so this is, you know, this is the church teaching.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我，你知道的，我把它当作，好吧，哇，好吧，所以这是，你知道的，这是教会的教导。

sentences.en: I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我理解这一点。

sentences.en: But then I began to understand it's not even a philosophical question.
sentences.zh: 但后来我开始明白这甚至不是一个哲学问题。

sentences.en: It's not even a religious question.
sentences.zh: 这甚至不是一个宗教问题。

sentences.en: Science tells us this.
sentences.zh: 科学告诉我们这一点。

sentences.en: And it was actually not until I, I'd say the year of 2020, when I had my eyes open, you know, after George Floyd, after all of this injustice.
sentences.zh: 事实上，直到我，可以说是2020年，我的眼界大开，你知道的，在乔治·弗洛伊德事件之后，在所有这些不公之后。

sentences.en: And I remember my freshman theology teacher, I remember him telling me in 2020, when I felt so conflicted about the election, I had no peace.
sentences.zh: 我记得我的大一神学老师，我记得他在2020年对我说的话，当时我对大选感到非常纠结，我内心毫无平静。

sentences.en: I almost felt like I had to choose between all of these social justice issues.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得我必须在所有这些社会正义问题之间做出选择。

sentences.en: I had to look at race.
sentences.zh: 我必须关注种族。

sentences.en: I had to look at economic equality.
sentences.zh: 我必须关注经济平等。

sentences.en: I had to look at climate change with the wildfires, with just everything that was, everything that was dividing our nation.
sentences.zh: 面对野火，面对一切，所有分裂我们国家的事物，我必须关注气候变化。

sentences.en: And I remember him telling me, Jess, if we're not respecting life before birth, we can't be surprised that we're not respecting it after birth.
sentences.zh: 我记得他对我说，杰斯，如果我们不尊重出生前的生命，我们就不能对出生后不尊重它感到惊讶。

sentences.en: So, it struck me.
sentences.zh: 所以，这触动了我。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow, wow, wow.
sentences.zh: 哇，哇，哇。

sentences.en: Abortion is a social, is a social justice issue.
sentences.zh: 堕胎是一个社会问题，是一个社会正义问题。

sentences.en: It opened my eyes.
sentences.zh: 它让我大开眼界。

sentences.en: And I realized that if we respect life when it begins, when we respect life in the womb, then I can just imagine,
sentences.zh: 我意识到，如果我们尊重生命之初，当我们尊重子宫里的生命时，我就可以想象，

sentences.en: I can only imagine the transformation that would occur with all of these other issues.
sentences.zh: 我只能想象在所有这些其他问题上会发生怎样的转变。

sentences.en: It just, it made sense to me of, wow, we really do need to be, we need to be pro-life for the whole life.
sentences.zh: 它只是，它让我觉得，哇，我们真的需要，我们需要为整个生命周期的生命而反堕胎。

sentences.en: And we have to remember who's being affected.
sentences.zh: 我们必须记住谁受到了影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I used to honestly see abortion as like very, like, yes, no, like that's yes, no, and not really understanding what women are going through in these moments.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我曾经把堕胎看作是非常，就像，是的，不是，就像那是是非题，并没有真正理解女性在这些时刻经历了什么。

sentences.en: And that needs, totally needs to be understood.
sentences.zh: 这需要，完全需要被理解。

sentences.en: I feel like from both sides, it's not always black and white.
sentences.zh: 我觉得从双方来看，事情并不总是非黑即白的。

sentences.en: And the woman who's going through, who's going through this most vulnerable moment is not thinking it's black and white either.
sentences.zh: 而正在经历这个最脆弱时刻的女性也并不认为这是非黑即白的。

sentences.en: Do you understand why someone would choose that?
sentences.zh: 你理解为什么会有人选择那个吗？

sentences.en: Choose abortion?
sentences.zh: 选择堕胎？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And here, and that's another thing.
sentences.zh: 而且在这里，那是另一回事。

sentences.en: It's like, I'm learning too about the language of like choosing abortion.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，我也在了解关于像选择堕胎这样的语言。

sentences.en: We need to change the language.
sentences.zh: 我们需要改变语言。

sentences.en: And like, even when I catch myself saying things, I'm like, oh no, Jess, like there's a completely other way to say it.
sentences.zh: 就像，甚至当我发现自己说出某些话时，我都会想，哦不，杰斯，还有完全另一种表达方式。

sentences.en: A lot of the times these women feel like there is no other option, that they aren't choosing it.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，这些女性觉得没有其他选择，她们不是在选择它。

sentences.en: They really feel like that there's no other option.
sentences.zh: 她们真的觉得没有别的选择。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: Do you allow for the possibility that they could see it as an option that they would want?
sentences.zh: 你是否允许存在这样一种可能性，即她们可能会将其视为她们想要的一个选项？

sentences.en: Like, and, and I, you know, it's such a, it's such a sensitive and personal experience.
sentences.zh: 就像，而且，你知道，这是一个，这是一个如此敏感和个人的经历。

sentences.en: And it's, it's just so, it's, it's hard.
sentences.zh: 而且它，实在是，它，很难。

sentences.en: It's hard.
sentences.zh: 这很难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed this conversation.
sentences.zh: 我很享受这次谈话。

sentences.en: And I was like, honestly, it's okay if I'm stumbling in the podcast, that's important.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，老实说，我在播客里结巴也没关系，这很重要。

sentences.en: Cause it's, it's real.
sentences.zh: 因为它是，它是真实的。

sentences.en: It's real.
sentences.zh: 它是真实的。

sentences.en: And that, that, and that happens in real life conversation.
sentences.zh: 而且这，这，这在现实生活的谈话中会发生。

sentences.en: So don't be afraid, like, keep that in.
sentences.zh: 所以不要害怕，就像，保留那个。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers）。

sentences.en: A podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 一个完全关于对设计的热爱以及围绕它的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ时，每晚你都要带300件你最珍贵的财产去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了这样一个像充满50年历史精美文物的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Do I believe the pro-life movement is winning?
sentences.zh: 我认为反堕胎运动正在获胜吗？

sentences.en: I believe the pro-life movement 100% is winning.
sentences.zh: 我认为反堕胎运动百分之百正在获胜。

sentences.en: Across the board.
sentences.zh: 全方位地。

sentences.en: My name is Brian Westbrook, Executive Director of Coalition Life.
sentences.zh: 我叫布莱恩·韦斯特布鲁克，是“生命联盟”执行董事。

sentences.en: I am, in fact, 37 years old.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我确实37岁了。

sentences.en: I have six children and a beautiful wife at home.
sentences.zh: 我有六个孩子，家里还有一位美丽的妻子。

sentences.en: We've been married for an amazing 15 years, almost 16.
sentences.zh: 我们已经结婚了惊人的15年，快16年了。

sentences.en: And I've been doing pro-life work.
sentences.zh: 我一直在从事反堕胎工作。

sentences.en: We started in 2009, so about 13 years.
sentences.zh: 我们从2009年开始，所以大约13年了。

sentences.en: Well, Brian, let's start with where were you when you heard about this leak from the Supreme Court, you know, this draft decision?
sentences.zh: 那么，布莱恩，我们先从你听到最高法院这次泄密事件，也就是这个裁决草案时，你在哪里说起？

sentences.en: Where were you at that exact moment?
sentences.zh: 在那个确切的时刻你在哪里？

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, I was distracted from what I should be doing, which is putting the kids to bed.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我当时分心了，没去做我该做的事，也就是哄孩子们睡觉。

sentences.en: Because it came in, I think, later in the day.
sentences.zh: 因为它是，我想是较晚时候发布的。

sentences.en: I was perusing some news articles.
sentences.zh: 我当时在浏览一些新闻文章。

sentences.en: And sure enough, this one popped up.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，这一条弹了出来。

sentences.en: And so I dumped it into our staff chat.
sentences.zh: 于是我把它发到了我们的员工聊天群里。

sentences.en: And then it just blew up with all of these different, you know, has anyone actually seen the actual document?
sentences.zh: 然后它就彻底炸锅了，各种声音都有，你知道的，比如“有人真的看过实际的文件吗？”

sentences.en: And not to give you any trouble, but we rarely trust media sources directly.
sentences.zh: 无意冒犯，但我们很少直接信任媒体来源。

sentences.en: No offense taken, Brian.
sentences.zh: 没关系，布莱恩，我没放在心上。

sentences.en: We want to do our own fact-checking.
sentences.zh: 我们想做自己的事实核查。

sentences.en: And what did you think, Brian, when you saw that?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，当你看到那个时，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I mean, what went through your head?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你脑子里想的是什么？

sentences.en: The very first thought that went through my head is that someone's going to lose their job.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里闪过的第一个想法是有人要丢饭碗了。

sentences.en: And what does that mean for the integrity of the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 那对最高法院的公信力意味着什么？

sentences.en: But did you think that it would potentially be good for the pro-life movement?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有想过这可能对反堕胎运动有利？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, potentially the leak maybe in some ways kind of seals the deal.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道的，可能这次泄密在某种程度上可以说是板上钉钉了。

sentences.en: Like, how did you see the—
sentences.zh: 比如，你是怎么看—

sentences.en: No, I don't see that the leak at all seals the deal.
sentences.zh: 不，我不认为这次泄密有什么板上钉钉的。

sentences.en: Not even in the slightest bit.
sentences.zh: 一点也没有。

sentences.en: So the document's date is February 10th.
sentences.zh: 所以文件的日期是2月10日。

sentences.en: Here we are in May.
sentences.zh: 现在我们来到5月。

sentences.en: And a lot could have changed between February 10th and today that we don't know about.
sentences.zh: 从2月10日到今天，可能会有很多我们不知道的变化。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because we know that human beings, we change our minds.
sentences.zh: 因为我们知道人类是会改变主意的。

sentences.en: Human beings, we have a sense of being influenced.
sentences.zh: 人类是会受到影响的。

sentences.en: And so I want to make sure that we are, number one, praying, but also working diligently, knowing that potentially Roe v.
sentences.zh: 所以我想确保我们，第一，在祈祷，但也必须努力工作，因为我们要知道罗诉

sentences.en: Wade might be overturned.
sentences.zh: 韦德案可能会被推翻。

sentences.en: But this document doesn't prove that one way or another.
sentences.zh: 但这份文件并不能证明这一点。

sentences.en: Now, June 27th, we might get a decision.
sentences.zh: 现在，6月27日，我们可能会得到裁决。

sentences.en: And at that point, there might be a little party that we might hoSt.
sentences.zh: 到那个时候，我们可能会举办一个小小的庆祝派对。

sentences.en: But anything prior is going to be too soon.
sentences.zh: 但在此之前的任何时候都为时过早。

sentences.en: Well, Brian, could you crystal ball it with me a little bit for a second?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，你能陪我用水晶球稍微预测一下吗？

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, you're right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，显然你是对的。

sentences.en: This is a draft.
sentences.zh: 这是一个草案。

sentences.en: It was a leak.
sentences.zh: 这是一次泄密。

sentences.en: You know, people have their own minds.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们都有自己的想法。

sentences.en: This could be fluid.
sentences.zh: 这可能是多变的。

sentences.en: It could change.
sentences.zh: 它可能会改变。

sentences.en: But it's also a fairly significant hint of what might actually be coming, right?
sentences.zh: 但这也是对实际可能发生的事情的一个相当重要的暗示，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think we can completely ignore it and say it's nothing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们不能完全忽视它并说它什么都不是。

sentences.en: In your mind, kind of casting your mind forward to the end of June, in the event that actually the Supreme Court does strike down Roe, you know, how does that make you feel?
sentences.zh: 在你的脑海里，把思绪投射到6月底，如果最高法院真的推翻了罗案，你知道，你对此有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I mean, what comes to mind when you imagine that scenario?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你想象那个场景时，脑海里浮现出什么？

sentences.en: So if, in fact, Roe versus Wade is overturned and the Dobbs case comes down on June 27th,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果罗诉韦德案真的被推翻，多布斯案在6月27日做出裁决，

sentences.en: it really just means that the so-called pro-life or pro-abortion battle is then distributed over 50 states.
sentences.zh: 那实际上只意味着所谓的反堕胎或亲堕胎之争随后将分摊到50个州。

sentences.en: And really what it means is that our job just got harder.
sentences.zh: 实际上这意味着我们的工作变得更难了。

sentences.en: And so our viewpoint is that we need to continue growing in Missouri, but that strategy needs to be augmented.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的观点是，我们需要在密苏里州继续发展，但这一战略需要加强。

sentences.en: And we know that a lot of women are now exiting the state.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道现在有很多女性正在离开该州。

sentences.en: They're going to Illinois.
sentences.zh: 她们去了伊利诺伊州。

sentences.en: They're going to Kansas.
sentences.zh: 她们去了堪萨斯州。

sentences.en: They're going to other places.
sentences.zh: 她们去了其他地方。

sentences.en: And just recently, we went up to a suburb of Chicago called Blossmoor.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，我们去了芝加哥的一个郊区，名叫布洛斯莫尔。

sentences.en: And so we have sidewalk counseling up there.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里开展人行道咨询。

sentences.en: And so whenever we go to a sidewalk, to an abortion facility, it's always armed with resources and help for those women.
sentences.zh: 所以每当我们去人行道旁、去堕胎诊所时，总是带着为这些女性准备的资源和帮助。

sentences.en: And then we're looking at the other 16 abortion facilities in the Chicago region.
sentences.zh: 然后我们正在关注芝加哥地区的其他16家堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: And how could we staff all of those all the time?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何随时为所有这些诊所配备人员呢？

sentences.en: And then look at the, you know, at least back in October, there was 788 abortion facilities around the country.
sentences.zh: 再看看，你知道的，至少在10月份的时候，全国各地有788家堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: And so if we had the funding and staffing, we would be at 788 abortion facilities today.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们有资金和人员，我们今天就会出现在788家堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: And Brian, what does that look like in front of you right now?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，现在在你面前的是什么样的情况？

sentences.en: I mean, who is doing it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是谁在做这件事？

sentences.en: I mean, it's certainly our group, of course, you know, we're doing that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然是我们的群体，你知道的，我们在做这件事。

sentences.en: But the groups I'm in collaboration with are leaders of pregnancy centers for the most part.
sentences.zh: 但我合作的群体主要是怀孕中心的领导者。

sentences.en: These pregnancy centers, I think they were looking about three to five years, they're looking to add 25 extra pregnancy centers.
sentences.zh: 这些怀孕中心，我想他们原本计划在三到五年内增加25个额外的怀孕中心。

sentences.en: In Illinois.
sentences.zh: 在伊利诺伊州。

sentences.en: But we must outnumber the number of abortion facilities, at least three to one, if not five to one.
sentences.zh: 但我们的数量必须超过堕胎诊所的数量，至少三比一，甚至五比一。

sentences.en: And so in Missouri, we outnumber the abortion facility 75 to one.
sentences.zh: 所以在密苏里州，我们的怀孕中心与堕胎诊所的比例是75比1。

sentences.en: So our 75 pregnancy centers to their one abortion facility.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有75个怀孕中心对他们1个堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: And so we need to be doing that in every single state across the entire nation.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要在全美每一个州都这样做。

sentences.en: I think the pro-life movement is stronger today than it ever has been.
sentences.zh: 我认为今天的反堕胎运动比以往任何时候都更加强大。

sentences.en: And I do not believe the Dobbs case is going to make much of a change there.
sentences.zh: 我不认为多布斯案会在那里带来多大改变。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it will only energize the pro-life movement and make us stronger even still.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为它只会为反堕胎运动注入活力，让我们变得更加强大。

sentences.en: And so there isn't some plan to have a party and stop and, you know, go home and, you know, sit on our laurels.
sentences.zh: 所以并没有什么计划要开个派对然后停下来，你知道的，回家，你知道的，躺在功劳簿上。

sentences.en: In fact, there is a very, very strategic plan behind the scenes if, in fact, Roe versus Wade is overturned,
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果罗诉韦德案真的被推翻，幕后有一个非常非常具有战略性的计划，

sentences.en: which really then, as I mentioned, and everyone else in the pro-life movement is seeing this, actually just makes it more difficult because our job just got harder,
sentences.zh: 正如我所提到的，反堕胎运动中的每个人也都看到了这一点，这实际上只会让情况变得更加困难，因为我们的工作变得更难了，

sentences.en: because we need to serve all of these women at the local level,
sentences.zh: 因为我们需要在地方层面上为所有这些女性服务，

sentences.en: also fight each one of these battles separately in all 50 different states.
sentences.zh: 还要在全美50个不同的州分别进行每一场战斗。

sentences.en: My name is Anya Baker, and I'm 27.
sentences.zh: 我叫安雅·贝克，今年27岁。

sentences.en: I live in Jackson, Mississippi, and I am married.
sentences.zh: 我住在密西西比州杰克逊市，我已婚。

sentences.en: I have two little boys.
sentences.zh: 我有两个小男孩。

sentences.en: One is three.
sentences.zh: 一个三岁。

sentences.en: One is one-year-old.
sentences.zh: 一个一岁。

sentences.en: And my one-year-old has multiple disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我的一岁孩子有多重残疾。

sentences.en: And the organization I work with now is the Susan B.
sentences.zh: 我现在合作的组织是苏珊·B·安东尼基金会教育基金，其服务范围广泛。

sentences.en: Anthony List Education Fund, which expands across many services.
sentences.zh: 基金会教育基金，其服务范围广泛。

sentences.en: So what this means is not just explicitly pro-life centers, but also groups that just assist along the way, whether that be a prenatal chiropractor,
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着不仅是明确的反堕胎中心，还包括一路提供协助的团体，无论是产前脊椎按摩师、

sentences.en: lactation, transportation, housing, addiction recovery, basically anything and everything that can affect a woman who is pregnant or parenting
sentences.zh: 哺乳指导、交通、住房、戒瘾康复，基本上任何和所有能够影响怀孕或育儿女性的事物，

sentences.en: and try to find resources in those worlds and bring them together.
sentences.zh: 并在这些领域寻找资源并将它们汇集起来。

sentences.en: So I got involved at 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 所以我15岁时就参与进来了。

sentences.en: Often you will hear people say, I grew up in a home where we were just pro-life from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 你经常会听到人们说，我从小在一个从一开始就是反堕胎的家庭长大。

sentences.en: Many women in my family, I have a Hispanic family,
sentences.zh: 我家族中的许多女性，我是西班牙裔家庭，

sentences.en: have experienced abortion.
sentences.zh: 都经历过堕胎。

sentences.en: Not all of them are on the same page about what they think abortion policy should be.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有人在对堕胎政策的看法上都意见一致。

sentences.en: But this came upon me.
sentences.zh: 但这件事降临到了我身上。

sentences.en: And I think even my family members who find themselves pro-choice are appreciative of the side of the movement that I've been able to expose them to,
sentences.zh: 我想即使是我那些自认为是支持堕胎选择权的家属，也很感激我能让他们接触到运动的这一面，

sentences.en: which is legitimately caring and legitimately meeting needs.
sentences.zh: 那就是合法地关心他人、合法地满足需求。

sentences.en: But Anya, I want to go back to when you were 15, because I guess in my mind I'm thinking, why would a 15-year-old get so interested in this?
sentences.zh: 但是安雅，我想回到你15岁的时候，因为我想在我的脑海里思考，为什么一个15岁的孩子会对这个这么感兴趣？

sentences.en: I mean, you could be, I don't know, going to the mall, playing video games, being a 15-year-old.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你本可以，我不知道，去商场，玩电子游戏，做一个15岁的孩子。

sentences.en: Like, why such a serious topic for you at that age?
sentences.zh: 为什么在那个年纪对你来说这是一个如此严肃的话题？

sentences.en: Like, bring me back to that moment.
sentences.zh: 比如，带我回到那个时刻。

sentences.en: Well, Mississippi has some of the highest unplanned pregnancy rates, some of the highest teen pregnancy rates, as you probably have heard before.
sentences.zh: 好吧，密西西比州拥有全美最高的意外怀孕率之一，最高的青少年怀孕率之一，正如你可能以前听说过的那样。

sentences.en: And I did have peers who had become pregnant or who had considered abortion or adoption or parented young.
sentences.zh: 我确实有同龄人怀孕了，或者考虑过堕胎、送养，或者很年轻就为人父母。

sentences.en: I had seen it myself.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼见过。

sentences.en: And I recall a friend reaching out to me, I believe when I was 15 and she was 16.
sentences.zh: 我记得有个朋友联系了我，我想我当时15岁，她16岁。

sentences.en: And why she called me, I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 她为什么打电话给我，我真的不知道。

sentences.en: You could call that divine providence.
sentences.zh: 你可以称之为天意。

sentences.en: You could just call it the rapport we had.
sentences.zh: 你也可以称之为我们之间的默契。

sentences.en: But I needed to know where to send her.
sentences.zh: 但我需要知道该把她送到哪里去。

sentences.en: And so when this came across my, you would say my death, but I was 15.
sentences.zh: 所以当这件事来到我的，你会说是我的死亡，但我当时15岁。

sentences.en: So, you know, in plain view for me,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，对我来说显而易见，

sentences.en: I knew, okay, this is going to keep happening.
sentences.zh: 我知道，好吧，这种事还会继续发生。

sentences.en: I'm going to need to know where to send people.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道该把人送到哪里去。

sentences.en: And she was able to connect with a student group and a church that helped her with child care, that people supplied me with items to drive down to give her.
sentences.zh: 她能够联系到一个学生团体和一个教会，他们帮她照顾孩子，人们给我提供物品让我开车送去给她。

sentences.en: And stories like that have sprung up time after time all across our state.
sentences.zh: 像这样的故事在我们全州一次又一次地涌现。

sentences.en: You mentioned, Anya, that this question kept popping up.
sentences.zh: 安雅，你提到过这个问题不断出现。

sentences.en: I mean, were there a lot of young women in your life, girls in your life in school who this happened to?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在你生活中的年轻女性中，学校里发生这种事的女孩多吗？

sentences.en: Yes, and especially in college.
sentences.zh: 是的，尤其是在大学里。

sentences.en: Many, many women that I went to school with or found are pregnant on campus club would come to us.
sentences.zh: 许多许多和我一起上学或发现自己在校园俱乐部怀孕的女性都会来找我们。

sentences.en: We had a baby shower for student parents at Mississippi State that first served 15 student parents.
sentences.zh: 我们在密西西比州立大学为学生父母举办了一场婴儿派对，最初为15位学生父母服务。

sentences.en: And then the next year doubled to 30 student parents.
sentences.zh: 然后第二年翻倍到了30位学生父母。

sentences.en: Do you have a memory, Anya, of anyone you were working with during those times who was struggling with the choice of whether to have an abortion?
sentences.zh: 安雅，你对在那些日子里共事的、正挣扎于是否堕胎抉择的任何人有什么记忆吗？

sentences.en: I mean, was that, did that ever come up for you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是，你遇到过这种情况吗？

sentences.en: Yes,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: I had a very good friend to this day who I barely knew in high school who reached out to me because she had seen me posting on social media about if you ever need support or resources to reach out.
sentences.zh: 我有一个至今关系很好的朋友，在高中时我们几乎不认识，她联系了我，因为她看到我在社交媒体上发帖说如果需要支持或资源随时可以联系。

sentences.en: And she took the better part of an entire month to make her decision because she knew she was pregnant pretty early on.
sentences.zh: 她花了大半个月的时间才做出决定，因为她很早就知道自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: She had a big window to obtain an abortion.
sentences.zh: 她有很长的时间窗口来做人工流产。

sentences.en: And she really was grappling with her own decision.
sentences.zh: 她真的在与自己的决定做斗争。

sentences.en: And of course, I want her to make her own decision and tell me what she needs.
sentences.zh: 当然，我希望她自己做决定并告诉我她需要什么。

sentences.en: I want to serve her in the way that she wants to be served.
sentences.zh: 我想以她希望的方式为她服务。

sentences.en: And really, she wanted to parent her child, but she was worried about a number of things like, will my parents accept me?
sentences.zh: 实际上，她想抚养自己的孩子，但她担心很多事情，比如，我的父母会接受我吗？

sentences.en: This child was not going to be just white.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子不会只是白人。

sentences.en: Were there going to be racial tensions around the fact that her child was mixed race?
sentences.zh: 她的孩子是混血儿这一事实会带来种族紧张局势吗？

sentences.en: And that's something she had to confront within her own family.
sentences.zh: 这也是她在自己的家庭中必须去面对的事情。

sentences.en: And was she going to have what she needed financially or where was she going to live?
sentences.zh: 她能否获得经济上的支持，或者她将住在哪里？

sentences.en: And so these are the things we had to walk through together.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是我们必须共同经历的事情。

sentences.en: And I think it's completely understandable to be afraid in any of those scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我认为在任何这些情境下感到害怕都是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: You wanted her to make her own decision, but would it have been hard to support her if that decision was abortion?
sentences.zh: 你想让她自己做决定，但如果这个决定是堕胎，你会很难支持她吗？

sentences.en: I would have not driven her to an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我不会开车送她去堕胎。

sentences.en: I would have not given her information to obtain an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我不会给她提供堕胎的信息。

sentences.en: But oftentimes, women need support emotionally after they make that choice.
sentences.zh: 但很多时候，女性在做出那个选择后需要在情感上得到支持。

sentences.en: And so I would be able to point her towards professionals who can help her piece out the maybe complex emotions she's having.
sentences.zh: 因此，我能够引导她去找那些能够帮助她理清可能复杂的内心感受的专业人士。

sentences.en: And she ended up parenting her child, who is a beautiful little boy to this day.
sentences.zh: 最终她抚养了自己的孩子，直到今天，他还是一个漂亮的小男孩。

sentences.en: She went on to marry a man who has become dad to that little boy.
sentences.zh: 后来她嫁给了一个男人，那个男人成为了这个小男孩的爸爸。

sentences.en: And she's had two more children and started her own business.
sentences.zh: 她又生了两个孩子，并创办了自己的公司。

sentences.en: And she says all the time that when she was, I believe, 17 at the time, she saw no future for herself.
sentences.zh: 她经常说，我想当时她17岁的时候，她觉得自己的生活毫无希望。

sentences.en: She thought that perhaps abortion was the only way for her to find happiness.
sentences.zh: 她曾以为堕胎或许是她找到幸福的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And I've seen her bloom and help other women in her own same situation later on.
sentences.zh: 我看着她绽放，后来又去帮助其他处境相同的女性。

sentences.en: How did you see your work?
sentences.zh: 你是如何看待自己的工作的？

sentences.en: Like, do you think of yourself as a feminist?
sentences.zh: 比如，你认为自己是一个女权主义者吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think that the goal of feminism is to elevate women.
sentences.zh: 我认为女权主义的目标是提升女性的地位。

sentences.en: And I don't believe the vision of feminism includes removing the reproductive quality of a woman.
sentences.zh: 我不认为女权主义的愿景包括剥夺女性的生育属性。

sentences.en: I believe that society needs to take women for all that they are and not treat their fertility like a disease.
sentences.zh: 我相信社会需要接纳女性的全部，而不是把她们的生育能力当作一种疾病。

sentences.en: Anya, do you feel embraced as a feminist or do you feel like you have been rejected by other feminists?
sentences.zh: 安娅，你觉得自己作为一名女权主义者受到了接纳，还是觉得自己被其他女权主义者排斥了？

sentences.en: I know there are times where pro-life feminist friends of mine have been, for instance, disinvited to the Women's March.
sentences.zh: 我知道有时我的一些反堕胎女权主义朋友曾被取消参加“女性大游行”的资格。

sentences.en: I know that in college, when I said I was writing for a pro-life feminist publication, I had a professor say, well, that's kind of an oxymoron, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我知道在大学里，当我D说我在为一本反堕胎女权主义刊物写稿时，有一位教授说，嗯，这听起来有点自相矛盾，不是吗？

sentences.en: So I understand that there's rejection involved, but I'm fully embraced by the communities that I want an embrace from.
sentences.zh: 所以我明白其中存在排斥，但我得到了我希望从中获得接纳的群体的充分接纳。

sentences.en: And so I ultimately don't feel rejected.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终并不觉得自己被排斥了。

sentences.en: Where were you, Anya, when you heard the news about the leak of the draft from the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 安娅，当你听到最高法院意见草案泄露的消息时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: I was actually nursing my baby, just sitting at home with my family.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在给孩子喂奶，正和家人坐在家里。

sentences.en: I said out loud to my husband, did we just overturn Roe?
sentences.zh: 我大声问我丈夫，我们刚刚推翻罗伊案了吗？

sentences.en: And he wasn't prepared for that question.
sentences.zh: 他没有准备好回答这个问题。

sentences.en: So he said, what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 所以他说，你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: And so I pulled up the article from Politico for him.
sentences.zh: 于是我为他调出了Politico的那篇报道。

sentences.en: And we just, everyone was, I'm sure, as in your world, was texting and calling each other, trying to find out if this was legitimate, what it means, has this happened before?
sentences.zh: 然后我们就——我相信和你们的世界一样，每个人都在互相发短信、打电话，试图弄清楚这是否合法、这意味着什么、以前发生过这种事吗？

sentences.en: Or, yeah.
sentences.zh: 或者，是的。

sentences.en: I don't feel it's the time yet to make toast, but I feel hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在还不是庆祝的时候，但我感到充满希望。

sentences.en: So I think that's where I have to reside until we have more information.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在我们获得更多信息之前，我只能抱有这种心态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You're referring to the fact that it's just a draft.
sentences.zh: 你指的是这仅仅是一份草案的事实。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think time and time again, you know, different challenges have come to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为一次又一次地，你知道，最高法院迎来了不同的挑战。

sentences.en: And being in Mississippi, knowing that the challenge is coming from our own state, I think Mississippi sometimes can be the butt of jokes.
sentences.zh: 而且身处密西西比州，知道挑战来自我们自己的州，我认为密西西比州有时会成为笑柄。

sentences.en: And to be able to set a precedent like this that sets free all of the states who've been working on the same things that we have is historical.
sentences.zh: 能够树立这样一个先例，让所有和我们做着同样努力的州都获得解放，这是具有历史意义的。

sentences.en: It makes you feel like you're experiencing something that is going to be written about or, in this instance, recorded for us to understand for years to come.
sentences.zh: 这让你觉得你正在经历某些将被载入史册的事情，或者在这个例子中，被记录下来供我们未来多年去理解。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that in a way, it's your home state that made the history.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在某种程度上，是你的家乡创造了历史。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm really proud.
sentences.zh: 我真的很骄傲。

sentences.en: This was built by regular people.
sentences.zh: 这是由普通人建立的。

sentences.en: So to see that opinion reflected in the major court of opinion is really encouraging because we feel seen.
sentences.zh: 因此，看到这种观点在主流民意法庭上得到反映，真的非常鼓舞人心，因为我们觉得自己被看到了。

sentences.en: You feel seen.
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己被看到了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Anya, thank you so much for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 安娅，非常感谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
